id: title:Gilbert09:accept an already parsed manifest object in assemble manifest

observations.behavior: Adds support for accepting already-parsed JSON objects alongside strings; previously rejected non-string inputs immediately.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion configurations supplied as parsed dicts rather than raw JSON strings, while retaining existing string handling.

observations.behavior: Adds tests and implementation changes: P1.F2.H3 adds a new assertion that checks no mutation of input manifests during secret injection. P1.F2.H4 adds assertions checking hosts are extracted from dict-manifests correctly.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes behavior to prevent credential leakage into caller's persisted config when passing pre-parsed manifests, and ensures host extraction works regardless of whether the manifest is passed as a dict or string.

observations.behavior: Replaces immediate rejection of non-strings with conditional parsing and deep-copying of object inputs before further processing.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports both API submission modes (string-encoded vs direct-object) without raising uncaught TypeErrors, while preserving security properties by not mutating shared state.
